headline: I stayed one year too long, or maybe walked away one conversation too early. Our ending was an OFF-BY-ONE ERROR.
caption:
I stayed one year too long, or maybe walked away one conversation too early. Our ending was an OFF-BY-ONE ERROR.

OFF-BY-ONE ERROR: a loop that runs one time too many or one time too few.
